_notes._about: Managed by the RSM-MSBA Nix environment (rsm-claude-settings). Refreshed on each rsm-setup / rsm-mkdir run. Delete the _rsmManaged marker to take ownership and stop it being overwritten. Strict JSON has no // comments, so docs live here and in _comment fields on each hook block.
_notes.permissions.allow: File creation/editing (Write/Edit), safe read-only inspection (cat/ls/pwd/echo/head/tail/wc/find/tree/which), network fetches (curl/wget), git read-only + safe writes (status/diff/log/show/branch/checkout/switch/add/commit/stash/restore), uv environment + package management (venv/add/remove/run/sync/lock/tree/python/tool), just, and activating .venv before uv run.
_notes.permissions.deny: Block every non-uv install path (pip, pip3, python -m pip, uv pip install/uninstall) so pyproject.toml and uv.lock stay authoritative.
_notes.permissions.ask: Always prompt for file/directory deletion (rm/rmdir), remote shell / file transfer (ssh/scp/sftp), and destructive git operations (push/reset/rebase/merge/cherry-pick/clean).
_notes.permissions.defaultMode: default = show every permission prompt instead of silently accepting edits. Teaches students what Claude is doing on their behalf.

UserPromptSubmit._comment: Log each prompt into .claude/usage-log/ for instructor review — ONLY in course-org (rsm-msba-*) repos. File contents and tool results are never logged.

PreToolUse._comment: Log each tool call (name + short summary only) — course-org repos only.
Before every git commit: auto-stage the usage log (course-org repos only), then scan staged files for secret-like patterns (API keys, private keys, .env files).

PostToolUse._comment: Record a timestamp whenever pytest runs; the stale-tests Stop hook compares it against Python file mtimes.
Auto-format Python files with ruff after Claude writes or edits them (via uvx, so it works before ruff is a dep).

Stop._comment: On Stop: remind (do not block) if Python sources changed since the last pytest run, then surface any ruff findings.
